purpose: Teach: 東欧/山道/ナレーション/サーブ/スーツケース/露天風呂/ピント/節分

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、本気で、絶対、東欧、絶対、の絵本、絶対、読みたいな
lines.en: Mom, I really, really want to read that picture book about Eastern Europe.
lines.style: Urgent, insistent energy. Quick attack on the opening. Pressing, building intensity. The voice of a child who has already decided this matters and needs to convince her of it now.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが、本気で、絶対、山道、絶対、お運転、絶対、お得意なのよ
lines.en: Sho, your dad is really, truly excellent at driving on mountain roads.
lines.style: Gentle redirect. Warm but deliberate, like she's letting him know she heard him and is gently steering. Slightly dreamy—lost in thought about what he said. Soft, measured pace.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、テレビの、本気で、絶対、ナレーション、絶対、お声、絶対、優しいね
lines.en: Mom, the narrator on TV has such a kind voice, doesn't he?
lines.style: Quiet observation, almost to himself. Turning something over in his mind. Wondering aloud rather than asking for confirmation. Soft, almost whispered. A small noticing.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、テニスの、本気で、絶対、サーブ、絶対、頑張ってね
lines.en: Sho, do your very best with your tennis serve, okay?
lines.style: Warm encouragement. A light, supportive lift on the request. Not pushing hard—belief in him without pressure. The tone of a parent who knows what he can do.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼくの、本気で、絶対、スーツケース、絶対、おじいちゃんがくれたよ
lines.en: Mom, Grandpa gave me this suitcase—did you know?
lines.style: Quiet pride. A small announcement, like he's sharing something precious. Gentle at the edges but with a core of ownership. Looking to see if she notices what he values.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんと、温泉の、本気で、絶対、露天風呂、絶対、楽しんでいらっしゃい
lines.en: Sho, go enjoy the open-air bath with your dad, yes?
lines.style: Tender and releasing. A soft sending-off. Warm affection underneath. The voice of a mother letting him go to something good. Slight pause before the yes, like she's tucking the moment into him.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼくの、本気で、絶対、ピント、絶対、合ったお写真、絶対、見て
lines.en: Mom, look—my photo turned out in focus. Look!
lines.style: Bright, proud urgency. Quick opening. Rising energy, eager for her to see what he's done. Repeating the request with fresh excitement. The voice of someone who wants to be witnessed.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、本気で、絶対、節分、絶対、にお豆まきしましょうね
lines.en: Sho, let's throw beans together for Setsubun, shall we?
lines.style: Gentle invitation. Warm, almost playful. Drawing him into a shared ritual. Not commanding—inviting him into something they'll do together. Soft and close.
